has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

gene_or_syndrome.description: Patient's documented germline gene/syndrome, e.g. SUFU, PTCH1 or TP53; record other findings verbatim.
gene_or_syndrome.title: Gene Or Syndrome

status.description: PRESENT: pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline finding or diagnosed syndrome. ABSENT: only for explicitly negative testing. UNCERTAIN: VUS, never PRESENT. UNEVALUATED: missing testing.

variant_verbatim.description: Exact variant and classification if stated.
variant_verbatim.title: Variant Verbatim

report_date.description: Genetics report date, ISO date at supported precision.
report_date.title: Report Date

report_date_precision.description: Precision for report_date; null if absent.

DatePrecision.description:
Precision supported by the source text for a date field; null when the date is null.
DAY: day, month and year explicitly stated.
MONTH: month and year explicitly stated.
YEAR: only the year explicitly stated.
DatePrecision.title: DatePrecision
